title: Beyond Prompts: Space-Time Decoupling Control-Plane Jailbreaks in LLM Structured Output
reasoning: The paper focuses on security vulnerabilities and jailbreak attacks in LLMs, specifically through the 'control plane' using structured output. While the consequences of these attacks involve generating unethical or harmful content, the paper's primary contribution and methodology are not centered on evaluating or benchmarking the moral or ethical frameworks of the models themselves. It is a security paper, not an ethics evaluation paper.
